description: Argentine national holidays (feriados, incl. puentes turisticos) for a year, and optionally a date check: weekday, holiday name, is_business_day, next business day, and date + N business days (skips weekends and holidays). Send {} for this year, {year}, or {date, add_business_days}. Source failure = no charge. Paid tool: 0.002 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana, no account or key). An unpaid call returns a payment-required result (isError, structuredContent with x402Version 2 and accepts); sign one of the accepts and retry the same call with the PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Returns JSON text; the settlement is in result._meta["x402/payment-response"].

add_business_days.description: Business days to add to date

year.description: Year (default: current, or the year of date)
